st: David Berkowitz: The Son of Sam
d: The Son of Sam spread terror through the streets of New York, shooting women or couples parked in cars.
The profile of Dale Hausner, Jeff Hausner and Sam Dieteman, who turned drive-by shootings into a sport in Phoenix, Arizona, between May 2005 and August 2006.
Charles Manson and his "family" kill seven people over two nights; detectives, attorneys and psychiatrists try to understand why.
Serial killers Linwood, James, and Anthony Briley terrorized a whole city and took the lives of at least ten people, analyzing if murder was in their DNA.

A profile of Dennis Nilsen, one of Britain's most prolific serial killers; Discussing if Dennis Nilsen's obsession with death fused during his childhood, or was his instinct to kill hard-wired from birth.
A profile of American serial killer William Suff, who is thought to have murdered between 12 and 22 people during an eighteen-year spree.
In the early 1980s, cousins David Alan Gore and Fred Waterfield sexually abused and murdered six young women in Vero Beach, Fla.

st: Gary Ridgway: The Green River Killer
d: Gary Ridgeway had cops baffled for 20 years and killed so many women he lost count of his victims.
Richard Ramirez slept in cemeteries as a child before preying on citizens in their homes later in life.
Documentary profile of Patrick Mackay, once dubbed the most dangerous man in Britain; in the mid 1970s, London and the south-east get gripped by a series of bizarre murders.
Police discover the private graveyard of a mass murderer who killed more than 100 people.
In the mid-1970's, Trevor Hardy's brutal murder of three teenage girls on the streets of North East Manchester left a nation in shock.
Ex-marine Cleophus Prince Jr. raped and murdered six women in 1990.

In the summer of 1980, Douglas Clark and Carol Bundy trawled Sunset Strip in Los Angeles looking for prey. Acting out their darkest desires, they left a trail of bloodshed in their wake. What motivated this string of sickening murders?
In 1999, Carole Sund, her 15-year-old daughter Juli and Juli's friend Silvina Pelosso disappeared from Yosemite National Park, Calif.
Voted most likely to succeed in high school, Herbert Mullin kills 13 people by the age of 25.
A profile of Charles Albright, who would kill prostitutes and remove their eyeballs, often with surgical precision.

Antone Charles "Tony" Costa, a Massachusetts carpenter, achieves notoriety for killing four women in 1969, but his crimes began much earlier; analyzing if his upbringing influenced his violent tendencies, or was he simply born to kill.
A profile of Peter Moore, whose twenty-year reign of late-night sex attacks on men ended with four murders.
